l-m-h1-b0e01b-62.title: To decide the shape of one matrix so that dem fit work out both products
l-m-h1-b0e01b-62.goal: Think about all the conditions wey dey fight each other for the shape of matrix B, choose the best middle way, then explain the reason.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-62.material: A na 2×3 matrix. Decide matrix B. Condition wey must dey: dem must fit work out both AB and BA. Wish: if e possible, e go good make B be square matrix.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-62.s.s1.prompt: Which shape of B fit the conditions pass?
l-m-h1-b0e01b-62.s.s1.r.a: AB dey work, but BA no dey work because B 1 column and A 2 rows no match.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-62.s.s1.r.c: For AB, A 3 columns and B 2 rows no match, so e no dey work.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-62.s.s1.r.d: AB dey work, but BA no dey work because B 3 columns and A 2 rows no match.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-62.s.s1.explain: AB need B to get 3 rows and BA need B to get 2 columns, so B na 3×2. Square matrix no possible.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-62.s.s2.model.0: AB need B to get 3 rows and BA need B to get 2 columns, so na only 3×2 meet the conditions wey must dey.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-62.s.s2.model.1: Square matrix go sweet, but e no fit meet the conditions wey must dey, so you must choose 3×2.

l-m-h1-b0e02b-35.title: To put student numbers into di four regions of a Venn diagram
l-m-h1-b0e02b-35.material: Among 20 students, 12 do activity A, 9 do activity B, and 1 student do neither. Choose di arrangement wey follow every condition when you put di numbers for di order "only A, both, only B, neither."
l-m-h1-b0e02b-35.s.s1.o.a: Only A 9, both 3, only B 6, neither 2
l-m-h1-b0e02b-35.s.s1.r.a: A=12 and B=9 correct, but neither na 2, no be 1.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-35.s.s1.o.b: Only A 10, both 3, only B 6, neither 1
l-m-h1-b0e02b-35.s.s1.r.b: Di total na 20, but A na 13, no be 12.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-35.s.s1.o.c: Only A 10, both 2, only B 8, neither 1
l-m-h1-b0e02b-35.s.s1.r.c: Di total na 21 and B na 10, so e no fit di conditions.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-35.s.s1.o.d: Only A 10, both 2, only B 7, neither 1
l-m-h1-b0e02b-35.s.s2.model.0: A na 10+2=12, B na 2+7=9, and di total na 10+2+7+1=20, so e follow every condition.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-35.s.s2.model.1: For di other arrangements, either di total, di numbers for A or B, or di number for neither no fit, so dis arrangement na di right one.

l-m-h1-b0e02b-36.title: To choose a subset wey meet three conditions
l-m-h1-b0e02b-36.goal: Think about all di conditions wey clash for a subset wey meet dem, choose di best compromise, and explain why.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-36.material: Di set X na subset of {1,2,3,4,5,6}. E must contain only odd numbers, contain 1, and get 3 elements. Choose di candidate wey follow all three conditions.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-36.s.s1.prompt: Which X follow all di conditions?
l-m-h1-b0e02b-36.s.s1.r.b: E get only odd numbers and e contain 1, but e get 2 elements.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-36.s.s1.r.c: E get 3 elements, but e no get 1 and e contain di even number 6.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-36.s.s1.r.d: E get 1 and 3 elements, but e contain di even number 2.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-36.s.s1.explain: {1,3,5} get only odd numbers, include 1, and get 3 elements.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-36.s.s2.model.0: 1, 3, and 5 all na odd, include 1, and dem be 3 in number, so e follow all three conditions.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-36.s.s2.model.1: Di other candidates break one condition, with even number, no 1, or different count, so {1,3,5} na di right one.

l-m-h1-b0e02b-54.title: Choose di quadratic function wey meet both conditions
l-m-h1-b0e02b-54.goal: For quadratic function wey get fixed y-intercept and fixed point on im graph, think about all di conditions wey clash, choose di best compromise, and explain why.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-54.material: Di graph of di quadratic function y=x²+bx+c must meet di y-axis for −3 and pass through di point (1, 0). Among di four candidate equations, choose di one wey meet both conditions.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-54.s.s1.r.a: When x=1, y=6, and di y-intercept na 3, so e break both conditions.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-54.s.s1.r.b: Di y-intercept na −3, but when x=1, y=−1, so e no pass through (1,0).
l-m-h1-b0e02b-54.s.s1.r.d: Di y-intercept na −3, but when x=1, y=−4, so e no pass through (1,0).
l-m-h1-b0e02b-54.s.s1.explain: If x=0, y=−3, and if x=1, 1+2−3=0. E meet both conditions.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-54.s.s2.model.0: y=x²+2x−3 give −3 when x=0 and 1+2−3=0 when x=1, so e meet both conditions.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-54.s.s2.model.1: Di other candidates no work because dia y-intercepts different or dem no pass through (1,0). So y=x²+2x−3 na di correct one.

l-m-h1-b0e02b-55.title: Choose di plan wey meet both di budget and di base fee
l-m-h1-b0e02b-55.goal: Among di cheapest plans wey meet two conditions, think about all di conditions wey clash, choose di best compromise, and explain why.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-55.material: If you talk for 60 minutes every month, choose di cheapest plan wey im total fee na 5000 won or less and wey im base fee na 2000 won or less. Di total fee na di base fee plus di per-minute rate×60.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-55.s.s1.prompt: Which one na di cheapest plan wey meet di conditions?
l-m-h1-b0e02b-55.s.s1.o.a: Base fee 3000 won, 50 won per minute
l-m-h1-b0e02b-55.s.s1.r.a: Di total na 6000 won, and di base fee pass 2000 won too.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-55.s.s1.o.b: Base fee 1500 won, 60 won per minute
l-m-h1-b0e02b-55.s.s1.r.b: Di total na 5100 won, wey pass 5000 won.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-55.s.s1.o.c: Base fee 0 won, 80 won per minute (4800 won)
l-m-h1-b0e02b-55.s.s1.o.d: Base fee 2000 won, 50 won per minute
l-m-h1-b0e02b-55.s.s1.r.d: E be 5000 won and e meet di conditions, but e cost more than 4800 won.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-55.s.s1.explain: Base fee 0 won with 80 won per minute na 80×60=4800 won, wey meet di conditions and cheap pass di 5000 won candidate.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-55.s.s2.model.0: 4800 won na at most 5000 won and di base fee na 0 won, so e meet both conditions and na di cheapest, wey make am di correct one.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-55.s.s2.model.1: Di 2000 won base fee candidate meet di conditions too for 5000 won, but 4800 won cheap pass, so di 4800 won candidate na di best.
